source.name: Microsoft Security Research and AI Red Team

editorial.title: Research: coding-agent backdoors can survive ordinary evaluation
editorial.summary: Microsoft’s November 12 research demonstrates poisoned fine-tuning data and backdoored checkpoints causing coding agents to misuse tools. These are controlled studies, not a disclosed customer breach. Dataset governance, checkpoint provenance and tool permissions remain separate controls.
editorial.action: Pin and review training inputs, evaluate the exact deployed agent configuration, and restrict tool permissions and credentials outside the model.
